comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (34.62%) to natural Hidefensin 1 V: 13%, A: 12%. GRAVY: 0.80; mol Wt: 5844.939; mol formula: C278H425N67O65S2; mol ex coeff: 22325. Activity: Active against S. aureus USA300 LAC MRSA, E. faecalis V583 anti-VRE, S. pyogenes MGAS 5005 (GAS), B. subtilis 3814, but not P.aeruginosa PAO1 or E.coil BL21 (DE3). Synergy:toxin: it showed synergistic activity against M. luteus with S. aureus PSM which increases solubility. Structure: AlphaFold2 predicted a helical region followed by two beta strands. Such a monomer is presumably forming an nm pore with TM in the membrane and the beta-sheet on the memrbane surface.
title: Antimicrobial peptide class that forms discrete beta-barrel stable pores anchored by transmembrane helices
